current_source.coverage: This current-period passage only; full-Item coverage is not established.

expected_answer.result_status: supported limited description; comparison insufficiently evidenced
expected_answer.supported_current_claim: The provided FY2024 passage discloses possible cybersecurity-related operational disruption and exposure of sensitive information.
mandatory_qualifiers: A failed earlier search does not establish absence of the cybersecurity topic in FY2023.
